name: CreateFileTableLock
evidence: creates the two semaphores that guard the file client's handle table and its replies (OpenFileClient and FindFileHandle call it)

name: FindFileHandle
evidence: returns the entry of the file client's table of 32 open handles for a handle, or 0

name: HandleFileReply
evidence: the file client's reply handler: copies the reply out of the reply buffer's uncached address and frees the waiter's slot in g_semaphoreSlots

name: CreateFileRequestLock
evidence: creates the semaphore that keeps one file request at a time (LockFileRequests calls it first)

name: LockFileRequests
evidence: waits on the file client's request semaphore, creating it first when needed

name: UnlockFileRequests
evidence: signals the file client's request semaphore

name: RunFileClientCallback
evidence: the handler of command 0x80000013: calls the function and argument it is given when the function is set, then ends the handler with SyncAndEnableInterrupts

name: OpenFileClient
evidence: once, installs HandleFileReply and func_001F89F8 for the commands 0x80000011 and 0x80000013, binds the client to the IOP's file service, clears the handle table and hands the reply buffer over

name: ForgetFileClient
evidence: clears the file client's opened flag and its binding (LoadIopModules calls it before it resets the IOP)

name: CloseFile
evidence: sends the close request for a handle and waits for its reply (CloseStreamReader and CloseBufferedStream call it)

name: ReadFile
evidence: sends a read request for a handle into a buffer and waits for its reply (StartChunkRead and RefillBufferedStreamFromFile call it)

name: WriteFile
evidence: sends a write request of a buffer to a handle and waits for its reply (FlushOutputBuffer calls it)

name: ControlFile
evidence: sends request 5 with a mode and a block of data for a handle, answering modes 1 to 3 from the client's own state (PollChunkRead asks whether a read finished with it)

name: ClaimFreeFileHandle
evidence: only in PAL: under the file table's semaphore (CreateFileTableLock, D_002771C0) marks the first free entry of the 32 handles at D_00628940 used (0x10000000) and returns it, 0 when all are taken; PAL's open request OpenFile calls it

name: IsFileServiceVersionUnknown
evidence: only in PAL: compares the word the file service answered with (D_00628B68) with the library's version word at 0x2800DC ("2430") and with the word D_002771C8 points at (CompareMemory returns 0 for equal words), and those two with each other; true (1) only when all three differ from one another, i.e. the answer is neither known word. OpenFile fails with 0xFFFEFFFC when it is true, before it claims a handle

name: OpenFile
evidence: only in PAL: the open request on the IOP's file service, the counterpart of CloseFile and ReadFile (US has none: its linker dropped it, and the 4-byte leftover func_001F8C30 is not it). Locks the requests, opens the client if needed, checks IsFileServiceVersionUnknown, claims a handle (ClaimFreeFileHandle), sends the name (up to 0x400 bytes), the flags and the mode (the third argument) with command 0, and sets the handle's id and flags from the reply; returns the handle's index or a negative error
